subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.

He doesn’t travel such more/ these days/ because he is not well.
solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. He doesn’t travel such more .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence contains an error in part 2: "**He doesn’t travel such more**."
 
• The phrase "**such more**" is incorrect. The correct expression should be "**so much**" to indicate a reduced frequency of travel.
 
• The word "**such**" is generally used before nouns or noun phrases, while "**so**" is used before adjectives or adverbs.

Correct sentence: *He doesn’t travel **so much** these days because he is not well*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The usage of "**such**" and "**so**" often causes confusion:
 
 
• **Such:** Used with nouns to emphasize their quality or extent.
 
 
• Example: She is *such a good teacher*.
 
 
 
• **So:** Used with adjectives or adverbs to emphasize the degree.
 
 
• Example: He runs *so fast*.
 
 
 
 
 
• In this context, "**so much**" is the correct usage to describe the extent of traveling.

38:T
